planets.name: NGTS-34 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of NGTS-34 with a 43.1-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: NGTS-34 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around NGTS-34. Its orbit and size follow Kendall et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
